edges.reason: _msgSender() is required to equal the router or pair inside _transfer, gating who can transfer
transfer uses _msgSender() as the sending account
transferFrom uses _msgSender() as the spender for allowance deduction
approve uses _msgSender() as the allowance owner
onlyOwner modifier compares _owner with _msgSender()
onlyOwner guard restricts blockBots to the owner
onlyOwner guard restricts unblockBot to the owner
onlyOwner guard restricts setMaxTxPercent to the owner
manualswap requires _msgSender() == _teamAddress
manualsend requires _msgSender() == _teamAddress
renounceOwnership is guarded by onlyOwner
cooldown[to] is set to block.timestamp + 45 seconds, timestamp dependent gating
require(cooldown[to] < block.timestamp) makes transfer validity depend on the timestamp
block.timestamp is passed as the swap deadline
block.timestamp is passed as the liquidity deadline
_rOwned balances are reduced and increased with SafeMath sub/add
rTeam is added to _rOwned[address(this)] after a multiplication
_rTotal is reduced by rFee with SafeMath sub
_tFeeTotal accumulates tFee with SafeMath add
_getValues reads _taxFee to compute fee amounts with mul/div
_getValues reads _teamFee to compute team fee amounts with mul/div
_getRate divides the reflection supply derived from _rTotal
_getCurrentSupply reads and divides _rTotal
blockBots writes true into the bots mapping
unblockBot clears the bots mapping entry
_transfer performs an external router swap before balances are settled, classic reentrancy surface
_transfer forwards ETH to external recipients in the middle of transfer logic
_teamAddress.transfer pushes ETH to an externally controlled address
_marketingFunds.transfer pushes ETH to an externally controlled address
swapTokensForEth calls the external router, guarded only by lockTheSwap
startTrading calls addLiquidityETH with the whole contract balance
startTrading grants a maximum allowance to the router on the pair
_transfer delegates the actual movement to _tokenTransfer
_tokenTransfer calls _transferStandard
_transferStandard calls _takeTeam for the team fee
_transferStandard calls _reflectFee for the reflection fee
_transferStandard obtains amounts from _getValues
transfer forwards to _transfer
transferFrom forwards to _transfer
transferFrom calls _approve to reduce the allowance
approve forwards to _approve
balanceOf resolves the reflection rate via _getRate
manualswap invokes swapTokensForEth on the contract balance
manualsend invokes sendETHToFee with the contract balance
swapTokensForEth approves the router through _approve
_transfer enforces amount <= _maxTxAmount

_transfer reads cooldownEnabled to decide anti-snipe checks
_transfer reads the inSwap reentrancy flag
_transfer reads _isExcludedFromFee to decide takeFee

_transfer compares callers against uniswapV2Pair

setMaxTxPercent recomputes _maxTxAmount with mul and div
setCooldownEnabled writes the cooldownEnabled flag
swapTokensForEth calls into the router interface
_getValues obtains currentRate from _getRate
_getRate obtains supplies from _getCurrentSupply
amount parameter drives the limit, cooldown and fee logic of _transfer
contractTokenBalance is passed as the swap input
contractETHBalance is passed as the ETH amount to distribute
tokenAmount is the swap amount argument
amount is split evenly between team and marketing wallets
bots_ array is iterated and written into the bots mapping
maxTxPercent scales _maxTxAmount and is required to be greater than zero
tTeam is the token amount converted to reflection in _takeTeam
currentRate multiplies tTeam to produce rTeam
onoff is stored into cooldownEnabled

normalization_plan.reason: amount is the primary parameter of _transfer and only exists to drive its logic
contractTokenBalance is a temporary read of address(this) balance consumed directly by swapTokensForEth
contractETHBalance is a temporary read of contract ETH consumed directly by sendETHToFee
tokenAmount is the input parameter of swapTokensForEth and has no independent meaning
amount is the input parameter of sendETHToFee and is immediately split to the two wallets
bots_ is the only parameter of blockBots and is fully consumed by that function
maxTxPercent is the only parameter of setMaxTxPercent and only affects _maxTxAmount
tTeam is produced by _transferStandard and immediately consumed by _takeTeam
currentRate is computed from _getRate and used only to derive rTeam inside _takeTeam
onoff is the only parameter of setCooldownEnabled and merely toggles cooldownEnabled
